text: I tried Lanternwake Harbor in a roleplay. Two problems: 1) When the story weather is clear (day or night) there is no harbor picture behind the chat at all, just a plain grey (day) or plain dark (night) backdrop. The harbor picture only shows up when it's raining, snowing or foggy. 2) In daytime, quoted dialogue inside messages (the "..." parts) is pale grey on the cream message boxes and almost impossible to read. Please fix both.
My blue Velvet Casket copy still has a red background picture (red stained glass, red roses), so it still looks red overall. Make the theme's pictures blue as well, keep the same scenes.
